newsitem.title: USA: CIC, Philips in electronics pact.
newsitem.headline: CIC, Philips in electronics pact.

text.p: Communication Intelligence Corp on Wednesday said that it has entered into an agreement with Philips Electronics NV's Semiconductor unit to combine CIC's software with Philips' semiconductors.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.

The firm said the alliance will address the manufacture of consumer electronics devices. CIC also said it expects that CIC's Jot and QuickNotes products will become part of the TwoChipPIC Plus reference design for Microsoft Corp's Windows CE operating system.

CIC and Philips Semiconductors can provide faster time to market for manufacturers wishing to incorporate handwriting recognition, electronic ink compression and dynamic signature verification into handheld personal computers, personal digital assistants, Web phones, or smart phones running the Windows CE operating system, CIC said.
